exposure: COVID-19 infection during the first wave (May 2020-Oct 2020)
COVID-19 infection during the second wave (April 2021-June 2021)
cohort: Pregnant patients admitted to the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at a tertiary care hospital in Delhi, India, with laboratory-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection during the first and second waves of the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: The second wave of COVID-19 in India saw an increase in symptomatic patients, shortness of breath, oxygen requirement, ICU admissions, LSCS rates, and comorbidities like hypertensive disease of pregnancy compared to the first wave.
mod_finding: Marginally increased LSCS rates were observed in the second wave compared to the first wave.
